recommended_actions: Detect unauthorized communications from outside the organization
Implement IDS/IPS and customize their policy settings according to your organization’s environment
Monitor the internal network and detect unusual and suspicious traffic (e.g., by introducing NDR)
Check the content of the communication suspected or proven to be unauthorized or improper, and if necessary, block it or take alternative measures
Definition of and response to unauthorized communication are reviewed periodically by analyzing detection trends
Regularly review policy setting of IDS / IPS
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Unauthorized communication from the outside cannot be detected or blocked and unauthorized or improper access to internal systems may occur. In the event of malware infection, communication with the C&C servers (command and control server, a machine under the control of a malicious actor or hacker and used to direct or execute cyberattacks) on the Internet cannot be stopped.

controls.title: Logging internet access and activity
controls.overview: Aggregate internet connections and routing to ensure complete logging of all Internet access
controls.status_description: Periodic audit of the content of communications is conducted
recommended_actions: Obtain internet access logs
Use proxy servers or Secure Web Gateways (SWG) to obtain logs of all internet access (URL requests, DNS queries, etc.)
When introducing proxy servers or SWGs, restrict internet access that does not pass through the aggregation route
Regularly audit the contents of Internet access communications
Decrypt SSL/TLS traffic and monitor its content
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Access to internet is not logged, and in the event of an infection or other cyber incident, users and source devices cannot be identified quickly.

controls.title: Web access restriction (Implementation of web content filtering)
controls.overview: Define and restrict websites and web categories which allow or block access (e.g. implementation of web contents filtering)
controls.status_description: There is a regular review of websites and categories which allow or block access
recommended_actions: Define websites to which access is expressly permitted or expressly denied
Maintain a blocklist and add sites and site categories not necessary for business purposes, such as Internet storage services (cloud drive sites), video aggregation sites, social media, etc.
Use DNS filtering services to blocklist access to known malicious domains
Use allowlists for sites and site categories that are necessary for business purposes
Restrict access to websites by using web filtering function
Periodically review websites to which access is permitted or denied
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Information leaks to the Internet services (cloud storage, social media, bulletin board, web mail, etc.). Malware infection occurs due to access to a malicious site loaded with malware. In the event of malware infection, communication with the C&C servers (command and control server, a machine under the control of a malicious actor or hacker and used to direct or execute cyberattacks) on the Internet cannot be stopped.

controls.title: Attack detection and response to web application (Implementation of WAF etc.)
controls.overview: Detect and protect attacks on the Web applications from outside (e.g. implementation of WAF)
controls.status_description: There is a regular review of the conditions and content for detection
recommended_actions: Detect external attacks and intrusions to web applications
Inspect all traffic passing through to the web application
If traffic is encrypted, it should be inspected after SSL enabled device or decrypted
If it is difficult to change the network configuration, use a hosted Web application firewall
Defend against external attacks and intrusions to the detected web application
Regularly review filtering and detection policies for web applications, and review detected anomalies and suspected or proven external attacks and intrusions on web applications
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Attacks on important web applications cannot be detected and prevented from credential stuffing attacks, or attacks that aim to exploit specific vulnerabilities in the web application's infrastructure.

controls.title: Response to abnormal increase in traffic
controls.overview: Establish a policy for detecting and responding to abnormal increases in communication traffic.
controls.status_description: The detection status is checked regularly
recommended_actions: Monitor and understand "normal" traffic volumes
Understand normal load levels and communication traffic volumes to use as a benchmark, and receive alerts when the threshold is exceeded
Formulate a response to be followed when traffic exceeding the threshold is detected
Audit all external facing servers (public facing servers) and conduct an impact assessment to understand the impact in the event of a DDoS attack
Consider implementing a DDoS countermeasure (such as a solution) at the network boundary for servers whose outage or lower availability has a large impact
Create procedures and define the flow of response when DDoS attack occurs
Regularly check detected issues and implement measures to ensure stable operation, such as expanding network capacity if necessary
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Higher traffic levels may go undetected, resulting in network or service suspensions. DDoS attack may not be detected, and response could be delayed or lead to system/service suspension.

controls.title: Establishing and disseminating usage rules for remote access
controls.overview: Define and disseminate rules for users who are allowed remote access
controls.status_description: There is a regular review of which users are authorized for remote access and the relevant rules
recommended_actions: Define usage rules for remote access, including permitted users, purposes, environments, and necessary security measures
Communicate the remote access usage rules to users and provide access environments as needed
Minimize the remote access environment provided as an organization
Regularly review permitted users and necessary security measures for remote access
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Unplanned approach to remote access security may lead to reactive – and hence, inconsistent and incomplete – response to cyber threats, hindering the Organization's overall ability to maintain or improve its security posture.

controls.title: Control of remote access
controls.overview: Introduce measures to enable remote access to be used safely
controls.status_description: The measures for safe use of remote access are reviewed regularly
recommended_actions: Define and implement measures for secure remote access
Implement access control solutions, such as VPN and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), to encrypt communications that connect to internal networks from outside the company
Implement device authentication systems and terminal authentication systems, such as client certificate authentication
In addition to the ID / password authentication, implement a mechanism other than ID / password according to business or user's authority, such as onetime password authentication using hardware token
Restrict remote access from devices that have not completed required settings for safe access
Lock a remote terminal when the number of authentication failures exceeds a threshold
Terminate the network connection at the end of the session or after a period of inactivity
Introduce MDM products on mobile devices to allow remote hard disk erasure if lost
Separate workspace for business use when permitting full or partial use of a personally owned device for business use
Verify that remote access is being used securely
Monitor remote access usage, to ensure that, for example, only authorized users and devices are making remote access connections
If the Internet is directly accessible from a remote terminal, obtain access logs on the terminal
The measures for safe use of remote access are reviewed regularly
Periodically update hardware tokens and certificates to new ones
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Information leakage due to eavesdropping / interception of remote access communication may not be prevented. Unauthorized devices (e.g. personal devices that do not meet the security level defined by your organization and third-party devices that use stolen ID / password of executives and staff) can remotely access organization's systems. As a result, malware infection and information leakage are likely to occur. Remote access authentication may be permitted even when the initiator is using spoofed (stolen) credentials, who may be able to access unauthorized information.

controls.title: Wireless communication management
controls.overview: Establish policy for wireless communication usage, manage the devices that allow wireless communication, encrypt wireless communication data by strong encryption method
controls.status_description: The usage policy and safeguards for wireless communication are regularly reviewed
recommended_actions: Establishing wireless communication usage policy, including use of public wireless LAN (public Wi-Fi) during remote work
Implement measures to protect wireless communication, based on a wireless communication usage policy
Disable wireless communication on devices when there is no business need
Restrict access to permitted wireless networks when there is a business need
Use secure cryptographic algorithms, and communication and authentication protocols for wireless communications (e.g., 8021X, Wi-Fi Protected Access 2 (WPA2), EAP/TLS, AES)
Regularly review the wireless communication usage policy and measures for safe use
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Eavesdropping / interception of wireless communication may be possible, resulting in possible information leaks. Remote access authentication may be permitted even when the initiator is using spoofed (stolen) credentials, who may be able to access unauthorized information.

controls.title: Management of wireless access points
controls.overview: Manage the wireless access points that are allowed to connect to the network and ensure that no unauthorized wireless access points are connected
controls.status_description: Periodic review of wireless access point installation and management method is conducted
recommended_actions: Maintain, using a list/database/ledger, and manage wireless access points allowed to connect to your organization's network
Restrict access to the corporate network(s) if providing wireless access points to devices outside of your control, such as personal devices of employees or visitor devices
Detect that an unauthorized wireless access point is connected to the network and take measures such as removing it
Deploy wireless intrusion detection/prevention systems (WIDS/WIPS) to automatically detect and respond to unauthorized wireless access points
Periodic review of wireless access point installation and management method is conducted
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Connections to unauthorized access points may lead to eavesdropping and interceptions of internal communications, information leaks.

controls.title: Security check on incoming mail
controls.overview: Implement spam filtering and attachment malware scanning on incoming or inbound email
controls.status_description: Security check points are reviewed periodically
recommended_actions: Define security guidance for incoming email
Based on the defined guidance (above), email is checked, and incoming email is restricted if and as necessary
Implement email filtering solutions and services to perform virus scan on attached files
Block received email with attachments that include specific file extensions (such as bat, exe, vbs, lnk) and that are not required for business purposes
Implement filtering solutions and services to filter spam emails
Verify SPF, DKIM, and DMARC policies
Implement a mechanism to temporarily store emails with file attachments URLs (hyperlinks), and provide sufficient time for virus checks or updates to spam mail definition file
Analyze and block email attachments and URLs using sandbox features
Regularly review the security check guidance of incoming emails and implementation measures
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Incoming emails with malware attachments may be introduced to the organization, and an infection caused by it may not be prevented. Without the ability to verify the safety of the URLs present in the body of an email, it is possible for the organization's user to be lured to suspicious or malicious websites. Malware-attached email reaches users before the pattern file (malware definitions or spam registry) is updated, and malware infection cannot be prevented by antivirus / spam mail filter.

controls.title: Enabling security of outbound email communication
controls.overview: Implement measures to prevent misdelivery to incorrect recipients, unauthorized sending, and spoofing of emails
controls.status_description: The risk posture, concerns, risks, and specific steps within the outbound email security release flow, are all reviewed regularly; requirements for new detective/protective functionality are reviewed regularly implemented
recommended_actions: Define and implement measures to prevent misdelivered emails (e.g., to incorrect recipients), unauthorized sending, and spoofing in email communications
Implement email security features at the time of sending, based on defined measures
Restrict or block outgoing emails as necessary

Implement email filtering solutions or services to restrict or prevent autocompletion of recipient addresses ("To:" fields), and/or to remind the user to recheck sender addresses when sending email to prevent human error, and sending information to wrong people
Emails with attachments must be encrypted when sent to external recipients, and must be approved by a supervisor
Use a dedicated file sharing service to share files externally
Configure sender domain authentication such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC
Regularly review security measures governing outbound email, and implement new technology or review existing measures
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Outgoing email, if not confirmed by an approver, may lead to erroneous sending of email. Preventive controls on internal wrongdoing is not effective.

controls.title: Establishing and communicating policies or rules addressing use of cloud services
controls.overview: Establish and communicate to all users, stakeholders, and concerned parties rules for using cloud services

recommended_actions: Define policies and rules for safe use of cloud services
Define which cloud operators and services are permitted, or establish selection criteria
Is there a discrepancy between the service provider's and your organization's security policies?

Classify service providers according to the confidentiality and volume of data handled on cloud services, and identify and select requirements according to the classification
Document security measures required and other considerations that should be implemented or followed by the cloud service users, and duly notify this document to the users
Define the information that is allowed to be stored in the cloud service and label it according to its data classification
Understand all security risks that could materialize because of the use of cloud services
Appoint a person in charge (PoC, or point of contact) for service management and establish responsibility around management of security, for cloud services

Know the contact information of cloud service providers and your organization's international stakeholder parties (all of RACI), and establish an organizational system that can respond quickly in case of an emergency
Formally notify policies and rules to cloud service users
Regularly review the contents of policies and rules
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Using cloud operator services that do not follow appropriate security requirements can cause system suspensions and outages, or information leakage.

controls.title: Development of processes for the use of cloud services
controls.overview: Establish a workflow, such approval request forms, for the use of cloud services and include steps to address any required follow-up reporting
controls.status_description: These processes are reviewed regularly
recommended_actions: Develop a process for using cloud services
Establish a process to require prior request before using a cloud service, and the approving/management authority must check the request in line with selection criteria
Manage all cloud services in use in a list/ledger, including the intended use and supervising departments (or owning departments)
When ending the use of a cloud service, ensure a process to request approval for end-of-use, which involves confirming whether stored data is properly discarded, and update the list/ledger
When updating the contract or service for the cloud service, conduct a risk assessment for continued use
Cloud services are managed in accordance with the prescribed processes
Regularly review this process
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Using cloud operator services that do not follow appropriate security requirements can cause system suspensions and outages, or data leaks.

controls.title: Security settings for cloud services
controls.overview: Set appropriate configuration settings for cloud services on the user's end following establishing of a clear understanding of security and administration responsibilities to be followed by the user
controls.status_description: It is regularly confirmed that adequate security settings have been carried out
recommended_actions: Implement cloud service security settings that can be set by the service user
Use the recommended settings if such settings are provided by the cloud service provider or if there are industry standard or industry recommended settings
Identify and implement measures from guidelines that explain common configuration mistakes often made by both service providers and users
Review security settings as necessary according to changes to how the service is used, such as changes in data handled (stored, processed etc.)
Security administration settings are implemented comprehensively after understanding responsibilities around use (terms of use etc.) on part of cloud service users
Regularly confirm that network communication with cloud services, and the data and resources stored on the cloud services are properly protected
Continuously assess configuration and settings of cloud services, using tools such as CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Management) and SSPM (SaaS Security Posture Management)
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Improper or unsafe settings etc., may result in unintended information being made public, or access keys being disclosed.

controls.title: Visualization and control of cloud services usage
controls.overview: Inspect the access to the cloud service, grasp the usage situation, and control the use of unauthorized services
controls.status_description: Authorized and unauthorized services are regularly reviewed, and it is verified that usage can be controlled
recommended_actions: Monitor communication contents and detect unauthorized or disallowed use of cloud service that is not permitted
Prevent use of unauthorized or disallowed cloud services using technology systems (software, hardware etc.)
Use CASB or similar tools (e.g., SSL/TLS decryption) to monitor data uploads to cloud services, and set controls to trigger based on flagged content
Regularly review approved or disallowed cloud services to ensure that usage is controlled
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Insufficient oversight on the use of unauthorized use of cloud service (shadow IT), may result in improper use without the organization knowing of it. Insufficient oversight on the content of communication to cloud services may result in spread of malware infections or information leaks/data leaks.

controls.title: Enabling logging of systems and acquired logs
controls.overview: Acquire logs after determining the targets and how to obtain them
controls.status_description: The targets for log acquisition are reviewed periodically as well as methods for their acquisition
recommended_actions: Identify and define systems subject to logging, the location and period of log storage, etc, and obtain these log
Enable audit logging to acquire detailed information such as event source, date, user, timestamp, source address, destination address, and other useful fields
Obtain all access logs (including updates and deletions) to sensitive data
Synchronize the time sources across servers and network devices to ensure timestamps in the logs are consistent
Use at least two synchronized time sources across corporate assets
If relevant laws and regulations such as privacy protection are applicable, log information in compliance to such requirements
Log authentication/authorization events, data creation/update/deletion events, and user management events for each system service
Regularly confirm that logs are acquired to meet defined requirements
Raise alerts when logging stops or meets another failure event
Items and assets subject to log acquisition as well as methods for log acquisition are reviewed periodically
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Logs entries may be incomplete in their acquisition (recording), or items subject to logs may get missed out on, which may result in delays in detection of incidents. Insufficient or deficient logs may hamper analysis of logs, resulting in a lack of ability to conduct root cause analysis on incidents and understand the impact, after an incident has occurred.

controls.title: Storing, retaining, and protecting logs
controls.overview: Store logs for the required period and protect them from unauthorized access
controls.status_description: It is regularly verified that logs are protected appropriately, and there is no fraudulent access
recommended_actions: Confirm that the storage period of the acquired log meets national laws and industry regulations, but in general retain logs for at least 12 months
Check that the log storage location has sufficient storage space
Retain logs for an appropriately set number of past iterations (i.e. define and store a couple of iterations over the log's history)
Store logs in a location outside the system for or from which they were obtained, and/or at a remote location, geographically removed, to protect logs from tampering or unauthorized access
Restrict access to logs to the fewest number of users needed
Encrypt logs, if needed, based on a judgement of the importance of the information they contain
Regularly verify that logs are protected appropriately, and there is no fraudulent access
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Logs may be rendered open to tampering, deletion, or disabling during cyberattacks, which may hamper or disallow forensics and root-cause investigations in the aftermath of cyberattacks.

controls.title: Enabling analysis of acquired systems logs
controls.overview: If there is any suspicious behavior from analyzing the log, respond firstly by notifying the person responsible
controls.status_description: There is a regular review of analysis techniques and perspectives, as well as the methods for handling such events
recommended_actions: Analyze acquired logs and detect security events
Identify and centrally manage logs necessary for detecting signs of an incident
Define the mechanism for detecting signs of an incident, log analysis procedures, notification flow, etc.
Periodically analyze logs and specify incident warning thresholds for automatic detection to detect the signs of incidents according to the predetermined processes
Monitoring items and monitoring time (24 hours 365 days, business hours only, etc.) are determined according to business needs
When analyzing logs, instead of targeting all logs, eliminate irrelevant logs and extract meaningful logs to streamline analysis
Notify the appropriate personnel quickly when an incident is suspected
Build SOC (Security Operation Center) that handles 24 hours a day, 365 days a year
Analyze logs to estimate the impact and scope of detected events
Regularly review log analysis methods, viewpoints, and response methods
Review the analytical perspective of logs based on threat intelligence
Test the defined detection process for effectiveness and periodically reviewed it for improvement after the operation starts
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Detection of cyber-attacks may be delayed or impossible, delaying first response or other initial response measures.

controls.title: Enabling log correlation and analyzing logs across sources
controls.overview: Collect logs and data from multiple information sources and analyze & visualize the correlation between them (e.g. implementation of SIEM)
controls.status_description: Logs, data and methods for correlations analysis are periodically reviewed
recommended_actions: Security events are detected by correlating and analyzing multiple logs
Perform real-time analysis to detect correlation among logs using tools such as SIEM
Correlate and analyze multiple logs to notify and respond to detected events, in a manner appropriate to the specifics of the logs
Logs, data and methods for correlations analysis are periodically reviewed
Regularly tune the settings of log correlation analysis systems, such as SIEM, to improve the accuracy of correlation analysis
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Logs or traces (of incident activity) cannot be detected by looking at log in isolation (a few at a time) or at affected systems in isolation, in an absence of a comprehensive approach to look at multiple data points may result in missing these complex incidents, and delay response to the incident.

controls.title: Establishing and communicating policies or rules for the system development lifecycle
controls.overview: Establish and disseminate rules for design, installation, and operation which take security in system development into account
controls.status_description: Rules or processes are regularly reviewed
recommended_actions: Define rules and practices governing software development that take security into consideration
Define rules for system design
Define rules to classify data and enact measures to protect the data based on the identified sensitivity
Define rules to grant only minimum necessary privileges and restrict unnecessary access
Define rules addressing use of cloud services
Define rules governing system implementation and systems roll-out
Define secure coding guidelines for building secure, vulnerability-free systems
Define rules addressing use of external components in development software
Define rules addressing the operating and running of systems
Define rules addressing the acquisition of necessary logs
Define rules for vulnerability management and periodic security assessments and audits
Define change management rules that address modifications and changes to systems
Communicate established rules to responsible individuals
Periodically review established and defined rules
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Due consideration to information security, if deficient in the software and system development process, may lead to ad hoc and unsystematized approach to cybersecurity, resulting in potentially less secure or unsecure systems.

controls.title: Security-conscious system design
controls.overview: Design a system which takes security into account
controls.status_description: The security perspectives for designing a system are reviewed regularly
recommended_actions: For each nonfunctional and functional requirement of the system, understand and formalize the viewpoints to be checked at the design stage according to risk and business importance
Understand, starting from the planning phase in the development lifecycle, the system objectives and the information assets that should be protected from, and establish strategies to respond to risk
Establish a baseline configuration in accordance with system design principles such as the principle of developing for only the essential functionality
Enforce secure design principles, such as adhering to the principle of least privilege (PoLP) and ensuring that user input is validated

For each system, evaluate the business impact of system downtime in the event of a failure, and implement load balancing and redundancy in implementations to achieve the length of the acceptable downtime
Confidential information stored in reusable resources, such as memory, disk, or their caches, should be erased immediately when no longer needed
Identify metrics to be monitored, such as CPU usage, and configure appropriate alerts
Design a system, with due consideration to information security, following the viewpoints and methodology identified in the above organization stage

Conduct security reviews at the system design stage, and issue instructions for improvements, as needed, such as refinement or a review of the design, considering alternatives to meet security requirements, tentative or permanent countermeasure as necessary
When issuing requests for improvements stated above, reassess and confirm its implementation
Create system architecture diagrams to visualize communication and data flows
Regularly review the information security and cybersecurity aspects when designing information systems
Regularly update system architecture diagrams
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Inappropriate or insufficient consideration to information security during the design stage may result in repetitive steps or "loopbacks" to previous stages in the process, resulting in additional costs, and potentially resulting in unprofitable development and operations.

controls.title: Security-conscious system installation
controls.overview: Implement and test the system with security in mind
controls.status_description: The security perspectives for system installation and test are reviewed regularly
recommended_actions: Understand and formalize cybersecurity considerations to be checked at the system implementation and testing phases
Remove/disable unneeded configurations or settings in infrastructure or the source code based on the principle of least privilege
Educate developers on secure coding guidelines
Restrict access to infrastructure and source code
Use only latest, reliable external components in development, following due approval of their use by a specialist department or team
Use code signing and similar techniques to detect unauthorized changes to external components
Implement a function to validate input from the user in terms of data size, type, format, etc
Ensure your organization's data is protected from access by other users or their processes when sharing the same platform (so called, "multitenant platforms")
Prevent release mistakes or unwanted changes by building CI/CD pipelines
Implement and test the system in line with these formalized information security/cybersecurity considerations
Physically or virtually isolate system environment (production environment and development / test environment, etc.) according to the required security level
Create and select test data to meet test requirements

Use SAST/DAST (static/dynamic application security testing tool) to ensure that your system adheres to secure coding guidelines
Regularly review the security considerations during the system implementation and testing
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Inappropriate or insufficient consideration to information security during the development (implementation) and testing phases may result in release of unsecure systems, potentially increasing the possibility of the system going down due to cyberattacks, or of data leaks.

controls.title: Security-conscious system operation
controls.overview: Operate systems taking security into account
controls.status_description: The security perspectives for system operation are reviewed regularly

Use a dedicated device or system for important work (administrator work, etc) and separate it from other systems
Test the impact on other systems before changing the system configuration or settings
Analyze security impact of changes before changing system configuration or settings
Perform multi-factor authentication (MFA) when performing maintenance by remote access from an external network
Ensure that version support has not expired for all software acquired from outside the organization

If unsupported (beyond EoL - End of Life) software must be used for some reason, identify risks, implement additional measures such as isolation from external networks, and manage renewal and retirement plans
Physically or logically separate the interface between administrator functions and normal user functions
Restrict export of (or otherwise bringing out of) confidential information using technology-based controls, and require approval whenever such export etc. is needed
Operate and maintain the system according to the formalized security considerations
Confirm that the system is operated and maintained with security in mind, including when outsourcing
Manage tools, methods and personnel used to perform system maintenance
Securely manage the encryption key used in the system
Manage system configuration using infrastructure-as-code (IaC)
Use secure protocols such as SSH or HTTPS to access the administrative interface
Disable the default account for devices and services used in the system
Create and manage software bills of materials (SBOMs) included in the system
Regularly review the security considerations during the system operation and maintenance
Monitor availability (uptime) of system resources (servers, storage, networks, etc)
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Adverse impacts and fallouts from unauthorized or improper use of administrator access (manager access, when not properly managed and used for unauthorized purposes), may compound with the passage of time. The organization is unaware of out-of-support (EoL, End of life) products.

controls.title: Conducting vulnerability scans

Check for vulnerabilities in source code, such as by using means like SAST
Check for web application vulnerabilities, such as by using means like DAST and web application scanners
Check for vulnerabilities in external libraries, such as by using means like SCA

Test for whether communication is possible across network boundaries
Use scanning tools to detect misconfigurations or vulnerabilities in cloud environments or containers
Conduct source code review following discovery or reports of critical or especially notable vulnerabilities, and evaluate the need for specific response

Perform scans following discovery or reports of vulnerabilities
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: Vulnerabilities could persist within the system, and they can be exploited to gain unauthorized access from outside.

controls.title: Planning for business continuity with IT considerations (IT-BCP, etc.)
controls.overview: Determine important IT systems for the company and prepare for continuation and early recovery of those services in case of accident or disaster occur

Prepare contact lists, roles, and emergency contacts and communication channels inside and outside the organization
Use information processing facilities with sufficient redundancy to ensure availability

Conduct disaster/accident drills regularly and review preparedness
Periodically test response plans and recovery plans
Review plans based on test and actual recovery issues
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: In the absence of insufficient or improper disaster preparedness and advance planning, prompt response to suspension of business activities due to natural disasters or cyber-attacks etc. is made difficult, delaying recovery of business activities.

controls.title: Establishing and disseminating incident response policy – detection and initial response

Establish criteria for determining whether to classify a suspected incident as an incident and for assessing its level of impact and the priority of response

controls.insufficient_measures_risks: In the absence of a predefined response policy, it is systemic or organized response to incidents is not possible anymore. controls.title: Establishing and disseminating incident response policy – recovery and improvement
controls.overview: Establish a policy on incident recovery and improvement, including the Second Report or the "First Follow-up" Report and all subsequent reporting, and their sharing and communication; obtain Management approval of this policy and disseminate to concerned parties

Establish standards for disclosure to external parties, and disclose information appropriately
Communicate recovery actions and progress to external stakeholders
Publicly disclose recovery actions and recurrence prevention measures
In the event of an incident, the incident details and details about the incident response should be documented
Prepare a post-incident report summarizing the incident details, response actions, recovery actions, and lessons learned
Confirm that information security continuity, redundancy, and availability are maintained even in the event of system overload or cyber attacks
Obtain executive approval for the recovery and improvement policy, and communicate to concerned parties and stakeholders
Define roles for specialized response teams; define responsibilities of administrators (system admins, network admins, etc.)
Communicate the recovery and improvement policy to internal and external stakeholders and ensure understanding of roles and reporting flows
Review the recovery and improvement policy periodically; conduct reviews against challenges, issues, and lessons learned that are identified as part of executing the recovery and improvement policy
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: In the absence of a predefined response policy, it is systemic or organized response to incidents is not possible anymore. controls.title: Establishing and disseminating incident response procedures or operating guidance
controls.overview: Determine specific procedures for handling incidents and announce them

To quickly conduct forensic investigations, acquire detailed log and system information in real time using EDR etc. in cooperation with analysts

Create a procedure corresponding to each incident type (e.g. fraud, malware, internal fraud, etc.) is created

controls.title: Formation of incident response teams
controls.overview: Composition of a specialized team for handling incidents, defining roles in emergencies and normal times
controls.status_description: Organization members, and their roles and responsibilities are periodically reviewed
recommended_actions: Understand and formulate skills necessary for conducting root cause analysis for incidents, responding to them, and for studying measures to prevent a recurrence and select corresponding personnel and form a specialized team

Create an incident response flow diagram or chart showing not only the person in charge of technical response but also all relevant teams and departments (Relevant departments include the external public relations department, the business department that communicates with customers, the general affairs department that reports to the government and supervisory ministries, etc.)
Clarify the roles and responsibilities of stakeholders both during an event (incident) and in normal time
Develop an incident response team that is available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, physically or remotely
Periodically review your organization's members, and their roles and responsibilities
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: In the absence of a predefined procedure for incident response, ad hoc response to emergencies and incidents might run into rework and redoing of steps, because of a lack of clarity as to the personnel involved and their roles and responsibilities.

controls.title: Training the incident response teams
controls.overview: Training or simulations involving the incident response team
controls.status_description: Training contents are reviewed and training is conducted regularly
recommended_actions: Conduct reviews involving the incident response teams, of response procedures to be deployed for each risk scenario to identify areas for improvement; risk scenarios may include malware infection using spear phishing tactics, defacement of websites following access breach
Conduct incident response training for the incident response team and document the training content
Conduct tabletop or live training for incident response for each risk scenario
Prepare a training environment as needed to minimize the impact on operations
Review recorded training content then revise incident response policies and procedures
Review the training content and conduct regular training to account for latest threats
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: In the absence of a predefined procedure for incident response, ad hoc response to emergencies and incidents may prove to be insufficient.

controls.title: Cross-functional incident response training
controls.overview: Conduct incident response training not only for the incident response team but also for all relevant departments and officers and employees
controls.status_description: Training contents are reviewed and training is conducted regularly
recommended_actions: Conduct reviews that comprise participants across teams, functions, and departments (i.e. cross-functional reviews, not just limited to the incident response teams), and that also involve the organization's senior roles of response procedures for each risk scenario and identify areas for improvement; risk scenarios may include: malware infection using spear phishing tactics, defacement of websites following access breach
Conduct incident response training for internal departments and staff in addition to the incident response team, and document the training content
Conduct tabletop exercises or live/hands-on trainings for incident response for each risk scenario
Prepare a training environment as needed to minimize the impact on operations
Review recorded training content, and revise incident response policies and procedures

When identifying shortcomings, findings should not be limited to the incident response team; points of improvement involving all concerned teams, either in terms of teams that should be part of the role not assigned as such, or improvements in terms of a deficient response step in the procedure, both should be addressed
Conduct training involving important external vendors, contracts, and other involved and relevant third parties as needed
Review the training content and conduct regular training to account for latest threats
controls.insufficient_measures_risks: In the absence of full cooperation and communication between allied stakeholders, deficiencies and shortages of cooperation with stakeholders cannot be identified.
